obituaries.full_text:
Ken is survived by his wife of 62 years, Ella Katherine Greenage Clark, as 
 well as his four children, Kenneth S. Clark, Jr. (wife Lisa), Kathy Stella Clark, 
 Charles C. Clark IV, and Mary Lisa Clark (husband Edward); nine grand-children, 
 John Robert Clark, whom he raised (wife Amber), Rachel Clark, Catherine Clark 
 Goodall (husband Jack), Sarah Clark, Hannah Clark, Victoria Clark, Hunter Clark 
 Boccinfusco, Lydia Clark, and Ella Clark; and three great-grandchildren, Jacqueline, 
 Jensen and Jace.
